import java.util.*;
public class Csv {public static List<String> parse(String line){var result=new ArrayList<String>();var field=new StringBuilder();boolean quoted=false;for(int i=0;i<line.length();i++){char c=line.charAt(i);if(c=='"'){if(quoted&&i+1<line.length()&&line.charAt(i+1)=='"'){field.append('"');i++;}else quoted=!quoted;}else if(c==','&&!quoted){result.add(field.toString());field.setLength(0);}else field.append(c);}if(quoted)throw new IllegalArgumentException();result.add(field.toString());return result;}}
